claim: A complete run lasts six 30-second tracks and reaches a win or loss screen.
where: first screen, How it works, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo?qa=1; deterministic simulation; assert six tracks, 180000 ms, five choices, and visible win screen

claim: Three missed phrases end a run.
where: game goal, How it works, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo?qa=1; advance the deterministic game without input; assert exactly three misses and visible loss screen

claim: Play again resets the track, score, misses, and run changes.
sandbox: finish the deterministic sample; use Play again; inspect the new observable game state

claim: Real-run sound, assist, and remapped key settings stay in this browser.
sandbox: leave demo for a real run; change all three setting types; reload in the same clean browser context; verify controls restore

claim: Sample gameplay sends no gameplay or play data to another origin.
sandbox: record every request through an entire sample finish and restart; assert requests are same-origin and no local-storage entry is created

claim: The sample does not read or change real-run storage.
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: seed real storage with a sentinel, lose and reset the sample, then assert the sentinel is unchanged and sample state resets

claim: Pulse Run Complete costs $5 USD once and is not a subscription.
where: first-screen fact, pricing, license page, terms, public offer metadata
sandbox: fetch public offer metadata and compare the price type, amount, currency, deliverables, and unavailable checkout state with the visible offer

claim: Notes can be played with the keyboard and the four touch controls.
sandbox: place deterministic playable notes, press the mapped keyboard key and touch control, and assert both increase score

claim: The game targets 60 fps and measures at least 50 fps in a phone-sized browser under 4x CPU throttling.
sandbox: 390x844 Chromium viewport, 4x CPU throttling, active seeded sample, two-second requestAnimationFrame measurement
